roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
facilityType: a premier health and rehabilitation center
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers an opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff competency within a supportive environment.

As the Staff Development Coordinator, you will be responsible for assessing educational needs, developing, and implementing training programs for nursing staff. Concurrently, as the Infection Control Nurse, you will lead efforts in preventing and controlling infections, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and promoting a safe environment for residents and staff.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and infection prevention, we encourage you to apply and contribute to our commitment to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility.
Demonstrated experience in staff education/development or infection control.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to infection prevention and staff training.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
